name: Obey Me! Nightbringer
source:
Nightbringer is a sequel game to the original Obey Me!, in that the Main Character (aka "MC") — the protagonist that players experience the game through — is the same individual from the original Obey Me! storyline. While playing the original game and knowing the plot of the Main Story from said game does enhance the story experience of Nightbringer, new players are also able to pick up the game without having played the original.

The story of Nightbringer begins with MC receiving a mysterious text from an unknown person, who then transports them to the Devildom, and to a time in the past just after the Great Celestial War. At this time, the seven brothers have only recently fallen from the Celestial Realm, and the world of demons is an unstable, dangerous place for humans. Because of this, MC has little choice but to tell everyone they are a fellow demon: a difficult lie to maintain around a distrusting Lucifer. While neither he nor his brothers remember MC, they will be the key to helping MC return to their present timeline.

[from [url=https://obeymewiki.com/wiki/Obey_Me!_Nightbringer]Obey Me Wiki[/url]]
translation:
Nightbringer是原版《Obey Me!》的续集游戏，其中主角（又名“MC”）——玩家体验游戏的主角——与原版《Obey Me!》中的主角是同一个人！故事情节。在玩原版游戏并从游戏中了解主线故事情节的同时，确实增强了《Nightbringer》的故事体验，新玩家也可以在没有玩过原版的情况下上手游戏。

《暗夜使者》的故事开始于MC收到一个未知人物发来的神秘短信，然后将他们传送到了魔界，并传送到了天界大战刚刚结束的过去。此时七兄弟刚从天界陨落不久，魔界对于人类来说是一个不稳定、危险的地方。正因为如此，MC别无选择，只能告诉所有人他们是恶魔同伴：在不信任的路西法周围，这是一个很难维持的谎言。虽然他和他的兄弟都不记得MC，但他们将成为帮助MC回到当前时间线的关键。

[来自[url=https://obeymewiki.com/wiki/Obey_Me!_Nightbringer]Obey Me Wiki[/url]]
